scope: PAC-Bayes release contract for semantic/hybrid search recall on future production-like operator queries.

methodology.audit_fallback_bound: r_hat + sqrt((KL(Q || P) + ln(2 * sqrt(n) / delta)) / (2n))
methodology.loss: 1 when at least one relevant segment for a query is absent from the retriever top-k results; otherwise 0

current_bound.reason: No admitted production-realistic held-out semantic-search query set, calibration/test split, or frozen posterior exists yet.

required_inputs_for_non_vacuous_bound: calibration split separate from final test split
fixed prior over embedder and retriever hyperparameters
frozen posterior over embedder_id, embedder_tier, dimension, normalization, reranker policy, RRF k, and top-k
per-query relevance judgments with reviewer provenance

one_point_tightening.definition: Compute the additional held-out queries required to move the risk ceiling down by 0.01 after plugging in the measured KL(Q || P).
one_point_tightening.published_planning_floor: Use sample_size_floor_zero_miss_delta_0_01 for the 0.99 target until the posterior is measured.

confidence_record.claim: With 99% confidence, the currently admitted production-query semantic-search recall lower bound is 0.0 because the required held-out production-like query set and frozen posterior are not present yet.

source_artifacts.role: current deterministic fixture harness; not admitted as production held-out evidence

release_bundle_slot.note: The artifact is intentionally not promoted to a required release category while the semantic-search feature lacks admitted production held-out data.

validation.command: jq -e '.confidence_record.proof_id and .confidence_record.proof_category == 7 and .confidence_record.confidence_type == "bayesian" and .confidence_record.confidence_value == 0.99 and .current_bound.recall_lower_bound_99 == 0 and (.required_inputs_for_non_vacuous_bound | length) >= 6' docs/attestations/proofs/semantic-search-pac-bayes.json
